feeds.title: Applique and Patch Quilting
feeds.description: HI! I'm Rose Marie crazy about applique and patch quilts and hand quilting. Married for 44 years and retired. Living in North Bay, Ontario, Canada. My blog is about my passion for quilting and just a little bit about my life and family. I make the quilts that my heart tells me to.

feeds.title: Jo Avery » Applique
feeds.description: Hi! I am Jo Avery explores articles about Applique on Jo Avery's Blog. A lifetime of playing with fabric and yarn has culminated in a career as a teacher, entrepreneur, and designer. Jo's natural affinity for color and detail informs all her quilts as well as a love of intricate techniques such as needle-turn applique and embroidery. Straddling both modern and traditional quilting, she enjoys inspiring others through her workshops and retreats.

feeds.title: Sulky » Applique
feeds.description: Explore more about Applique on Sulky Blog. For over 30 years, Sulky of America has been inspiring consumers to have fun sewing by bringing the highest quality products to the marketplace and educating them on their numerous uses. Founded by Fred and Joyce Drexler, pioneers in the home sewing industry, the Sulky brand continues to be the most recognized and sought-after name in decorative threads and stabilizers.

feeds.title: Needle's Eye Stories
feeds.description: Quilting inspiration and tutorials; dimensional wool and cotton applique; stories of quilts; applique patterns. Teri Young and Kara Mason have been stitching partners for more than 20 years and have been in business together for over six years. Kara and Teri began teaching at local quilt shops in 2014, focusing on appliqué, embroidery, and ribbon work. They hope you will enjoy their tales of triumphs and failures as they embark on this new journey, telling stories through the eyes of their needles.

feeds.title: Applique Addict
feeds.description: Hi! I am Marjorie a quiltmaker with a love of applique. I continue to try to reduce the stash by attempting to make a dent in the pile of dozens of WIPs/UFOs and sew up some clothing.

feeds.title: WeAllSew » Applique
feeds.description: Explore articles, tutorials, designs, and more about Applique on WeAllSew. WeAllSew is a place where sewers and crafters of all ages and skill levels are celebrated and inspired through project ideas, patterns, and tips to fuel your creativity and love for sewing.WeAllSew is brought to you by BERNINA USA, an independent family-owned business that designs and makes top-of-the-line sewing machines that represent the best in innovation, quality, precision, and ease of use.

feeds.title: Quilting Daily » Applique Quilt Patterns
feeds.description: Our website serves online education programs, video services, and magazines all serve to meet the needs of the quilter wherever they may be. Building off the tradition and excellence of established brands including Fons & Porter, McCalls, Quiltmaker, and Quilting Arts, Quilting Daily is dedicated to inspiring, educating, and equipping quilters of all interests and skill levels.

feeds.title: Diary of a Quilter » Applique
feeds.description: Read the featured articles about applique, and applique designs on Diary of a Quilter. My name is Amy Smart and I'm a quilter, pattern and fabric designer, wife & mom. A personal blog about quilting, sewing, and life as a mother. Lots of free tutorials including beginning quilting tutorials, binding tutorials, and other sewing projects like bags, quilt blocks, and nursing covers.

feeds.title: Piece O Cake Blog » Applique
feeds.description: Get the latest articles on Applique Designs, Applique Tutorials, and more on Piece O Cake Blog. Hello! I'm Becky Goldsmith and I have gathered my favorite books, patterns, notions, and threads together on this site to make your hand sewing experience rich and relaxing.

feeds.title: Butternut Plaid
feeds.description: I have been quilting for about 30 years, as well as drawing and painting for most of my life. I learned about wool applique about 16 years ago and became hooked. I taught myself how to dye wool, ribbon, and thread. I loved hand stitching, so the embroidered embellishment of the wool fueled my passion for the technique. I started making my designs and eventually became the co-owner of a small wool applique design company. I'll share my passion and knowledge through this blog, which I hope will bring you many happy hours of blissful stitching.

feeds.title: Sew Outside the Box Blog
feeds.description: Get updated with the latest applique designs, applique patches, applique tutorials, and articles on Sew Outside the Box Blog Hi, I'm Diana. I LOVE to sew! I want you to love sewing, too. Learn to sew with sewing project kits, a fun and exciting DIY method to increase and enhance your skills. Build your sewing stash with cool tools.
